recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if a new work-group decision specifically asks to rename the current Group-scoped combination terminology or the Group.combinationMethod binding name.
issue_request: FHIR-35770 was a Published/Persuasive R5 CDS request to rename the EvidenceVariable CharacteristicCombination code system and value set to CharacteristicCombinationCode because EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination and its CharacteristicCombination binding/type name created duplicate names for code generators.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-35770 was found. Related R5 source work in commit 257b27a14fbae5c1bd725d3c46dfbbfcf5ed36df for FHIR-36131 removed EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination and replaced it with EvidenceVariable.characteristic.definitionByCombination; later commit b6ffbe50c67dfcc7f9ceac3463e582537ad2d85c for FHIR-42886 removed the EvidenceVariable.characteristic backbone and the EvidenceVariable-owned characteristic-combination terminology files.
additional_context: FHIR-36131 is Published/Persuasive with Modification and explicitly resolved to remove EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination. FHIR-42886 is Applied/Persuasive with Modification and makes Group the preferred resource for defining combinations of characteristics, replacing EvidenceVariable.characteristic with EvidenceVariable.definition. Current source/fhir.ini lists EvidenceVariable as active, current EvidenceVariable source defines EvidenceVariable.definition as a CodeableReference to Group, and the surviving combination terminology is Group-scoped as GroupCharacteristicCombination.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The original duplicate EvidenceVariable element/type naming problem no longer exists in the current build, and renaming the current Group-scoped terminology to CharacteristicCombinationCode would be a stale application of an R5 request.

related_jiras.note: Earlier R5 EvidenceVariable characteristicCombination redesign that established the CharacteristicCombination binding family.
Published R5 decision that removed EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination, eliminating the original duplicate element/type condition.
Added additional codes to the same R5 CharacteristicCombination value set before later refactors.
Later no-change issue states the requested CharacteristicCombination addition is satisfied by Group resource changes for EvidenceVariable use cases.
R6 refactor makes Group preferred for combinations and removes the EvidenceVariable characteristic backbone.
